title: Daily SGS Top 5
tagline: Five stories, one question: who's in control?

discovery_note: Stories found through X News (last 24 hours).

stories.headline: India demands equal veto for new UN Security Council seats
stories.summary: India told the UN General Assembly that any new permanent members of the Security Council (the UN's most powerful body) must get the same veto power as the current five.
stories.label: Slightly Sovereign
stories.why: Nations gaining more say inside a global body.

stories.headline: Greece, EU and allies declare Turkey–Libya sea deal "null and void"
stories.summary: Greece, Cyprus, Egypt, Bahrain, the UAE and the EU declared the Turkey–Libya sea-border deal "null and void" under the UN Law of the Sea, a global treaty on who controls which waters.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: Global law used to overrule a deal between two countries.

stories.headline: Report: Trump officials urge Orbán to run for UN Secretary-General
stories.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports Trump officials urged Viktor Orbán to run for UN Secretary-General. Nothing is confirmed.
stories.label: Moderately Sovereign
stories.why: A leader known for putting his own nation first, eyeing the UN's top job.

stories.headline: Oxfam: richest 0.1% out-pollute 3.5 billion people, ahead of COP31 climate summit
stories.summary: Ahead of COP31, the UN's yearly climate summit, Oxfam's "Disaster Divide" report says the richest 0.1% cause more pollution than 3.5 billion people, and calls for taxes on wealth and fossil fuels.
stories.label: Strongly Globalist
stories.why: A push for global taxes on wealth and climate.

stories.headline: UN ends 30+ years of missions in Somalia at Mogadishu's request
stories.summary: The UN's political mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) closes October 31 because Somalia asked it to, ending three decades of UN missions there.
stories.label: Strongly Sovereign
stories.why: A country taking back the job of building its own government.
